title: Apps & servers, helper agents and a fresh app look
summary: Apps & servers that connect your creative apps for you, helper agents, a fresh look and an easy Linux install.
added: New Apps & servers page: connect Blender, Godot, Unity, Figma and Blockbench with a checklist that ticks itself off.
PlazCode adds its own helpers to Blender, Unity, Figma and Blockbench and removes them on disconnect. Blender can also run in the background with safe mode on.
Guided browser extension setup on every system: PlazCode opens the extensions page and shows the folder to load.

Linux: install with one line, curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stoveez/PlazCode/main/install-linux.sh | sh . It adds itself to your app menu and updates itself. Roblox Studio through Vinegar is experimental.
Helper agents: the AI can start up to two extra chats to work on parts of a task at once.
Several commands per reply: reads run together, changes run in order.
A fresh app look with grouped pages, smoother page changes, glow and a theme builder.
Mac: now opens on macOS 10.15 Catalina too. Memory search needs macOS 12; on Catalina, use Firefox.
fixed: Notion: commands right after a sentence run again instead of sticking on processing.
DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and similar sites: the startup check no longer fails.
Commands no longer wait on the link between the extension and the app.
notes: Update the PlazCode app and the extension together (the app's updater does this).
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.
